_comment: Example for service/config.json (copy to config.json and edit). Secrets never go here: api_token comes from the RSI_API_TOKEN env var (or replace CHANGE-ME-OR-SET-RSI_API_TOKEN), the fixer API key comes from the env var named by fixer.api_key_env (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY), and the GitHub token comes from the env var named by github.token_env (GITHUB_TOKEN). Never commit real secrets in service/config.json.
